what: A single-coordinate multi-index has weight n/r j, with real division.
how: Unfold finite weighted sum, evaluate the single coordinate; independently checked support-sum composition uses four distinct facts including cast-zero and zero-division.
hypotheses: Universe-polymorphic sigma with Fintype; r:sigma→Nat, j:sigma, n:Nat. No DecidableEq or denominator positivity.
mathlib_api_audit: Finsupp.weight_single already supplies arbitrary semiring/module basis evaluation; original finite division sum requires ratio bridge. Finsupp.sum_single_index plus sum_fintype are generic primitives.
generalization: Native finite_kernel permits arbitrary zero-preserving kernels; finite_division permits DivisionSemiring values and arbitrary denominators. Bundled Finsupp.weight drops ambient finiteness and has existing API. These replace the parent representation, not a mechanical weakening of Roth.weight.
missing_api: No demonstrated missing singleton-evaluation mathematics; design issue is whether to expose finite cast/division convenience API or migrate parent weight to bundled support sums.
junk: Not dead: two explicit caller files; no simp attribute.
action: Re-aim at Finsupp.weight_single after coordinated parent weight migration; normalize smul/inverse to quotient at both Lattice155 and Theta391, then remove duplicate local singleton theorem once full caller modules compile. Transitional quotient wrapper belongs in Roth/Box.lean.
